features.label: Faced a firing squad
features.detail: Reprieved at the last second as a staged mock execution, then four years in Siberia. Everything after is written by that man.

features.label: Argues against himself
features.detail: Gives his strongest lines to characters he opposes. The Grand Inquisitor is unanswerable on purpose.

features.label: Wrote under compulsion
features.detail: A gambling addict working against debt and deadline. The chaos in the novels is not invented.
